shared_elements: standing human figures in profile-ish posture
pair or row of upright figures side by side
human legs shown separated in walking stance
justification: Both show upright human figures side by side, at least one holding an elongated implement (an axe-like object in A, staffs in B), which is a generic correspondence. Otherwise they differ entirely: A is a highly schematic pair of stick-like painted bodies with outlined limbs and no setting, while B is a naturalistic modelled procession of costumed attendants leading a two-humped camel between ornamental rosette borders, with animals and framing bands wholly absent from A.
